subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Meltwater - staffing + trace-capture dependency
body:
Anders,

Staffing: Milan 70% (TL), Quentin 60% on model training and the imitation targets, Jorge 50% on the ChampSim patch + trace tooling. Compute is light - these are small models; 16 titan-a100 slots best-effort covers all training.

The real dependency is M2 trace capture from production. Zeke (cc'd): we need read access to the retrieval-serving cache layer plus a sampling hook to log ~200M LLC-equivalent accesses. Your team's SLA on new taps has been 3+ weeks lately, and M2 lands Apr 24 - can we get the request in this week? Without it, M2 slides and the whole go/no-go compresses.

Also setting expectations on Python versions: the repo pins Python 3.7-era deps and the baselines package installs from a git commit; Jorge will containerize before anyone burns a day on env drift.

Ivo
